channel_ids.desc: List of encoded channel IDs to remove from the channel restriction list. Interpretation depends on the app's `channel_restriction_mode`, which is configured via the `admin.apps.permissions.set` method. Provide at least one of `user_ids`, `usergroup_ids`, or `channel_ids`.

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs whose named\_entities access will be revoked. Provide at least one of `user_ids`, `usergroup_ids`, or `channel_ids`.

usergroup_ids.desc: List of encoded usergroup IDs. Provide at least one of `user_ids`, `usergroup_ids`, or `channel_ids`.

desc: Revoke an entity's access to an app that has its permission type set to named\_entities

errors.app_acl_not_found: This app does not have an ACL.
errors.channel_not_found: One or more channel IDs are not valid.
errors.failed_to_update_channels: An error occurred while updating the channel restriction list.
errors.invalid_channel_restriction_mode: Cannot remove channels when channel\_restriction\_mode is all\_channels.
errors.invalid_permission_type: This app requires permission\_type to be set as named\_entities before removing users.
errors.named_entities_cannot_be_empty: There must be at least one valid named entity
errors.not_an_enterprise: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.
errors.restricted_action: User does not have permission to perform this action.
errors.too_many_named_entities: Too many named entities passed into the app permissions setting.
